programme.title: 夜王
programme.desc: The year is 2012. The once-glamourous Club EJ suddenly experiences a hostile takeover. Much like the nightclub industry, the glory days are over for the club's manager, Foon, despite having stood tall in East Tsim Sha Tsui for decades. To make things worse for Foon, the club's new CEO is none other than his cutthroat ex-wife, Madame V! Determined to change things up, she leaves Foon and his hostesses with no choice but to transform and modernize in order to breathe new life into their business. Little do they know, a powerful conglomerate has been pulling the strings all along to shut down Club EJ for good. To save their neon empire, Foon and V must join forces and make an epic last stand with the hostesses against what seems to be inevitable doom.

programme.title: 人間蒸發
programme.desc: Jia Jia went to Japan with her fiance to meet her family. As soon as she arrived at the foot of Mount Fuji, she was imprisoned by local villagers and led an inhuman life. The cowardly Hirota only knew how to sorrow through wine. Jia Jia's good sister Wei Ling resolutely went to Japan to find Jia Jia. With the help of agent Kinoshita, the investigation gradually deepened, but the surrounding environment became more and more sinister. Hirota was strangled to death in a hot spring pool. Michiko went mad because of extreme fear. Yuko was still sane but unable to express when she was attacked. Tadao often spied Wei Ling through the cracks in the door. Residents under the shadow of nuclear radiation gradually lost their humanity, like a hyena, and ready to bite Wei Ling this outsider.

programme.title: 愛情扯大纜
programme.desc: A story of the sad love between a man who dedicates his youth to the nearly 420-year-old tradition of the Sendai Grand Tug-of-War, and a Korean medical resident who works on Koshiki island, and what happens with them and their families.

programme.title: 掃毒3: 人在天涯
programme.desc: Hong Kong police agent Cheung works undercover in Kang's drug cartel, while another undercover cop Au successfully earns their trust in an incident, a brotherly-bond is built among the three. After the Police busts the syndicate in Hong Kong, Kang subsequently hide away in the Golden Triangle, by chance he receives a tip-off about the betrayal within his circle of trust..

programme.title: 七月與安生
programme.desc: Qiyue and Ansheng are two high school best friends. Qiyue is calm like water while Ansheng is a fiery ball of passion. As fate would have it, they fall in love with the same man, Jia-ming. Because of their different values and lifestyles, they are destined to arrive at two completely different endings..

programme.title: 秘密之丘
programme.desc: Sensitive 12-year-old Myung-eun (Moon Seung-a) is embarrassed of her working-class family and constantly lies to keep her true family situation a secret. When she writes, though, she is not constrained by reality. Pouring herself into essays, Myung-eun takes pride in constructing a different world of her own. However, the candid writings of a new student shake her sense of self, and prompt Myung-eun to better understand her family. Reminiscent of acclaimed coming-of-age Korean indies like The World of Us and House of Hummingbird, writer-director Lee Ji-eun's understated debut feature excels in its perceptive depiction of the emotions and experiences of a child trying to find her place in the world.

programme.title: 藍色巨星
programme.desc: Miyamoto Dai, a student with a passion for basketball, has an overnight life-changing experience after going to a jazz show for the first time. As if hypnotised by this music he knows nothing about, the young man decides to devote himself heart and soul to the saxophone and jazz becomes his new passion. Will he succeed in becoming a great musician.

programme.title: 愛情萬歲
programme.desc: Ching and Sung work in “Love Cafe” in the dazzling Soho and the main job is to cure broken hearts. But happiness won't last forever. After gathering with schoolmates, where Ching's ex-boyfriend Hung showed up, depute between Ching and Sung breaks out and their plan to study in Beijing almost vanishes... Joe met Kelly in a disco and falls into her in the first sight. However, Kelly is in fact a weapon of Joe's ex-girlfriend for revenge. But the more Kelly knows about Joe, the less she can pull herself out of the relationship... Yu has a handsome and career type boyfriend who will buy her everything. But what she needs is care which can't be bought. Sing, having a crush on Yu, always stands by her and comforts her desperate heart. But their 6-year age difference seems a gap that Yu couldn't step forward.

programme.title: 白塔之光
programme.desc: Gu Wentong, a middle-aged food critic, is drifting through the local eateries of vibrant Beijing with his younger photographer colleague Oyang. A divorce with a 6-year-old daughter and estranged from his father for decades, he is looking for a new perspective on life while reconsidering his failings as a father, a son, and a lover. While the seasons come and go, people get together and move apart. Only one thing will remain the same: The White Pagoda where they all meet sooner or later..

programme.title: 鐵三角
programme.desc: Life has not been kind to Sam, Fai and Mok as they struggle to make ends meet. Routine visits to bars seem to be their only way out of miseries. Until a stormy evening when a mysterious old man appears before them with a tip: An ancient treasure is buried under the high-security Legislative Building. All they have to do is sneak in and retrieve it; if they believe in his story. Sam, Fai and Mok agree to make a run for the treasure to test their fate. What they uncover is beyond anything they expected: An ancient coffin containing a ceremonial robe made of gold..

credits.director: 徐克, 林嶺東, 杜琪峯

programme.title: 孤島診療所 2022
programme.desc: Shikina Island is a beautiful island located on the western edge of Japan. Kensuke Goto (Dr. Coto) came from Tokyo 19 years ago to this isolated island, 6 hours by ferry from the mainland. Since then, he has been the only doctor on the island and has borne the responsibility for the lives of all its residents. Over the years, the islanders have come to trust Coto, and Coto has come to trust them. He has become an irreplaceable presence and family member to all. A few years ago, he married Ayaka Hoshino, a nurse who has supported Coto for many years, and Ayaka is now seven months pregnant. Together with Ayaka's parents, Shoichi and Masayo, fisherman Gori Hara, former head fisherman Shigeo and his friends, Mariko, who runs a bar, and Wada, who helps out at the clinic, they live a peaceful life on the island. Now in 2022, Shikina Island, like many other rural areas in Japan, is experiencing depopulation and aging. Despite this somewhere in the back of their minds the islanders.

programme.title: 深夜咖啡屋：消失了愛人
programme.desc: Bride-to-be Yoon waits for her groom Tae-young on their wedding day but he doesn't show up. Out of concern and anger, she searches for him all day and in the dead of night, she arrives at a strange place called 'Cafe Midnight', which opens from midnight until the sun rises. Upon entering Yoon finally finds Tae-young, but something doesn't seem right. He looks a few years younger and he doesn't even recognize her. As past, present and future merge, will the bride find her groom.

programme.title: 十月圍城
programme.desc: 1906, City of Victoria (British Colony of Hong Kong). In the distance of thirteen blocks, the one man who holds a nation's fate must survive relentless attempts on his life with only eight bodyguards to protect him. Against hundreds of assassins, these men must put their courage to the test in order to protect the hopes of millions in this perilous night even if it means fighting to the death..

programme.title: 世外
programme.desc: Tasked to help transient souls through Another World to their reincarnation, the spirit GUDO meets a young girl called YURI, and embarks on a dangerous journey to help her overcome her anger and prevent her curse from destroying the world.

programme.title: 心動
programme.desc: Ho-jun is a shy youngster, more interested in his guitar than school. A chance encounter between Ho-jun and Sheo-rou leads to a first sweet taste of romance. However..

programme.title: 賭霸
programme.desc: Do Do is everything Anita is not. Do Do is the brash, uncouth kind of a fishwife, while Anita is the personification of elegance, intellect and perfect deportment. Do Do works at a fish store but hopes to be a clairvoyant but Anita has this extra-sensory perception power by birth. Uncle's enterprise is in danger as top gambler Sung issues a challenge. Uncle asks Anita to take on Sung but she refuses. In desperation, Uncle goes to Do Do who playfully claims to be the ESP queen of gamblers..

programme.title: 黑馬王子
programme.desc: Wah is an unkempt, uneducated and undiplomatic guy who is doomed to be a loser of love. Bok Ping is a stylish Shanghai girl with a tycoon father. But Bok Ping decides to go to Hong Kong to seek her mother, who has departed from her when she was a child. She encounters Wah in the process and lives a simple life with Wah's mother. Wah, being influenced by Bok Ping, becomes more polite and cultured. Meanwhile, Bok Ping's father deems that Wah has kidnapped his daughter, but unexpectedly, Bok Ping has really been kidnapped..

programme.title: 猛鬼佛跳牆
programme.desc: It is a dream come true for engineer Bill Cheung when a quiet villa in the countryside is assigned to him as staff quarters. As soon as he moves into this extravagant estate with his wife and 2 daughters, strange things begin to happen. When his daughter Jane discovers the previous owners were burned to death many years ago, Bill's family is already on their way to a similar tragic demise..

programme.title: 追女仔95之綺夢
programme.desc: Dino Sau is a brilliant motor mechanic, able to supply a Mini Cooper with an engine powered by atomic energy. He falls in love with a beautiful, filthy-rich girl Vivian, but of course she already has a boyfriend. Years later, Dino is rich, and he meets his beloved again. She is now married to Gao Kun. Dino seeks the advice of an evil-minded guru, who implants him with dreams in which he can have his object of desire..

programme.title: 烈火戰車
programme.desc: Andy is a seasoned motor-cycle driver. His ultimate goal is to enroll in Grand Prix Racing. But in a private race, a severe crash almost took Andy's life..

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 戀上你的床
programme.desc: Carrie left Raymond not because he had too many other women, but only because he slept with another woman right on the bed Carrie has always been obsessed with. After the break up, she begged for ownership of the bed she's gotten used to. Carrie was assigned to follow the story of city's celebrated super cop, Paul Ko. While exchanging fire he was shot at by an AK-47 and become a sexual impotent. During the process of interviewing, Carrie has fallen to Paul. Raymond is being considered for a promotion to district court, his superiors request for him to stay away from the night-life and women. In the thick of this difficult celibate period, an 18 year old girl called Tabby barges into Raymond's life..

programme.title: 萬象「芳」華: 英雄本色III
programme.desc: The year is 1974. A young Hong Kong Chinese, Mark, travels to Saigon to make his fortune. There, he encounters a mysterious femme fatale, the lovely Kit. As he becomes more involved in her various underworld deals, a tragic romance develops. On the eve of the outbreak of war, Kit's past returns to endanger her, and Mark must risk everything for the one true love of his life..

programme.title: 血玫瑰
programme.desc: Chieh-ying, the head of a Macau dancing group, has a peaceful and calm life. One day, five drunken men, who were the murderers of Chieh-ying's dad, came to watch the show and had a brawl with Chieh-ying. On her way home, Chieh-ying got caught. She was raped and tortured by them. After that, Chieh-ying felt herself sick and was contracted the venereal disease. Therefore, she decided to go to Hong Kong to seek vengeance. She met a journalist and stayed at his home. To earn a living, Chieh-ying worked as a barmaid at a bar of Chow, her sister's ex-boyfriend with the help from Susan. One evening, Chieh-ying saw one of those five men when she was on the way to work. Susan lured him away so Chieh-ying could kill him. Chieh-ying then started a trail of bloody revenge..

programme.title: 知法犯法
programme.desc: Police constable Mike is suspended from duty charged with abusing the use of his gun in a robbery. During his suspension from duty, Mike meets a Triad Society Big Brother, Tin, and admires his lifestyle and also his sexy wife. Mike is apparently dismissed but in fact becoming a stoolie. Mike eventually becomes Tin's bodyguard, and discovers that his buddy Chung also becomes a stoolie. Mike uses the Police Force to get rid of all big brothers and intends to become the head of the Society, as well as taking over Tin's wife. For his own sake, Mike even kills his buddy Chung and kidnaps Tin..

programme.title: 倫文敘老點柳先開
programme.desc: Lun was a smart scholar who liked to do petty tricks. Lau had been practicing martial arts. Lun and Lau formed an odd couple of school and had small disputes all the time.

programme.title: 黑馬王子
programme.desc: Wah is an unkempt, uneducated and undiplomatic guy who is doomed to be a loser of love. Bok Ping is a stylish Shanghai girl with a tycoon father. But Bok Ping decides to go to Hong Kong to seek her mother, who has departed from her when she was a child. She encounters Wah in the process and lives a simple life with Wah's mother. Wah, being influenced by Bok Ping, becomes more polite and cultured. Meanwhile, Bok Ping's father deems that Wah has kidnapped his daughter, but unexpectedly, Bok Ping has really been kidnapped..

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記之魔教教主
programme.desc: The film is originated from a famous Chinese Kung Fu fiction. Everybody fought for a pair of super weapons and wished to be the conqueror..

programme.title: 靈氣迫人
programme.desc: Angie was an undergraduate from Canada who was in holiday in Hong Kong as well as doing research work for her thesis - 'Chinese Superstition'. She looked for accommodation and met Hansom. While Angie disguised herself as a ghost to scare Hansom, he was thrown out of the window by a genuine ghost. Detective Valentino came to investigate the accident and they unfolded the actual happening of the tragic evening when Singer Lisa Law had shot her lover..

programme.title: 飛虎
programme.desc: Wong and his team are forced to team up with a bungling customs squad and their greenhorn leader, who happens to be a woman, to bring in a huge shipment of heroine..

programme.title: 天若有情
programme.desc: Wah Dee handles cars and bikes like a racing champion. To keep the police off his trail, he takes Jo Jo hostage. On the run, their desperate love is doomed from the start...

programme.title: 買兇拍人
programme.desc: Hong Kong is an over-crowded city, where people are easily provoked with confilcts. Hitman BART and assistant director CHUEN offer a bargain package 'YOU SHOOT, I SHOOT'.

programme.title: 猛鬼撞鬼
programme.desc: Taxi dancer Yue puts herself head over heels in debt because of gambling. She tries to borrow a loan from her close friend, Ngor, with tricks of suicide. She pretendedly pushes Ngor down a tall building but falls from the rooftop herself. She has got a narrow escape and a windfall of picking up a sack of money from a Chinese spiritualized vase which belongs to a big brother, Hung. With the help of the spirit, Yue and Ngor win so much that they almost lose their sense. They want to keep the vase themselves so they must get away from the pursuit of a killer sent by Hung, as well as another two mysterious detectives..

programme.title: 霸王花
programme.desc: Police Superintendent Wu is in charged with the duty of organizing Hong Kong's first all women police action squad. At first, her style of training is too harsh for the girls who are used to dates and dances. She is able to gain their respect and obedience eventually. The leader of the men's squad, Kan, falls for Wu and he has the most hilarious way of showing his love towards her. Wu's top shooter and fighter help her give the girls some fine tuning such as walking on fire. Their first real assignment finally arrives when they, along with the men's squad, are sent to guard a jewelry exhibition. The robbers capture both Wu and Kan in a shoot-out..

programme.title: 五億探長雷洛傳雷老虎
programme.desc: Andy Lau leads a star-studded cast in this chronicle of one young officer's rise to power within the Hong Kong police force in the 1950s.

programme.title: 五億探長雷洛傳 II之父子情仇
programme.desc: Lee Rock realizes the promotion is indeed the manoeuvre of his surrender of power. So he decides it is the right time to resign. His son, Yin, has graduated and joins the ICAC...

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲: 肝膽相照
programme.desc: A pair of childhood friends Ting and Kuo grow up to become an assassin and a police inspector. In order to solicit Ting's help in drug trafficking, triad boss Yang sets a trap for him..

programme.title: 黃飛鴻
programme.desc: Set in 1875, China. Wong Fei Hung and his disciples take on the unscrupulous dealers who are trying to entice gullible Chinese into slavery in America.

programme.title: 旺角卡門
programme.desc: A low-level trial 'big brother' has a hot-tempered 'littler brother' who can't keep out of trouble, and consequently is in constant need of being bailed out by his protector..

programme.title: 肥貓流浪記
programme.desc: Fat Cat, a good-natured but mentally retarded adult, is jailed for two years before being bailed out by the Social Welfare Department for good behaviour. Discharges and an orphan, Fat Cat is placed in the custody of a Social Welfare worker Bibi, but there is a communication gap between the two. One day, Bibi takes him to Lantau Island to visit his late parents' grave. As he is crying his heart out, Bibi is involved in a traffic accident, leaving him alone on the Island to lead a wandering life. Seized by cold and hunger at night, Fat Cat tries to steal food from a puppy and is spotted by a stubborn but kind-hearted elder, Granduncle. Failing to find where Fat Cat lives, he takes him home and adopts him. The presence of the simple-minded but optimistic Fat Cat brings much hilarity to the otherwise moribund village. He also wins the elder's favour for resolving the difference between him and his neighbouring youth James, and the three become good friends..

programme.title: 驅魔警察
programme.desc: Lam, an experienced policeman, had his quiet and beautiful life in Tung Ping Chau. He often tackled criminal cases with his supernatural power. One day, the old lady living next door came to ask him to go Hong Kong Island to get back the dead body of her daughter, a stewardess who was killed by the police as being suspected to be a drug smuggler. Lam's niece, Lin, a young country girl, was very interested in the life of Hong Kong and decided to go with Lam. At the Police Station, Lam knew that the 'Stewardess' was killed by 2 police sergeants, Yin and Miu, after a desperate struggle. Lam explained that the 'Stewardess' had actually been killed before she came back to Hong Kong. She had been turned to be a living corpse and controlled by a Japanese magician for smuggling..

programme.title: 龍鳳茶樓
programme.desc: Dragon and Pool are friends in the triad. Dragon saves Gigi and touches her at a life and death moment. But they have an inexplicable history which is a thwart to their love..

programme.title: 倩女幽魂
programme.desc: A rainstorm compelled Ling to trespass Lan Po Temple for a night. Ling meets attractive Siu Seen. Being unaware of Lit's murder, he is madly in love with Siu Seen..

programme.title: 肝膽相照
programme.desc: A pair of childhood friends Ting and Kuo grow up to become an assassin and a police inspector. In order to solicit Ting's help in drug trafficking, triad boss Yang sets a trap for him..

programme.title: 九龍冰室
programme.desc: Ex-convict Dragon works as a waiter after his release from prison. He has no idea that he is now a father, until his six-year-old son greets him 'Dad' upon his release..

programme.title: 快餐車
programme.desc: Thomas and David are two quick-witted vendors hawking Chinese fast food from their truck in the busy squares of Barcelona. Their acquaintance with beautiful pickpocket, Sylvia, brings them in contact with novice detective Moby, who is trying to track her whereabouts. Sylvia is actually a wealthy heiress kidnapped by the evil count, who is trying to siphon off her inheritance. The trio puts a spanner in the count's plans, and rescue Sylvia..

programme.title: 冷面狙擊手
programme.desc: James and John are working in the Commercial Crime Bureau. Jointly they look into a case of which the suspect is an influential rich business man called Lee. James has a girl friend called Suki who is working for Wong, Lee's accountant. One night, in a party holding by Lee, John hears by chance the internal tips on a stock that Lee and his staff are talking about. John thus takes out all his saving and buys that stock. In the meantime, since Wong is murdered and James is also assaulted and seriously burnt, the case is closed under great pressure. On the other hand, the price of the stock which John has invested heavily slides. John is thus deeply depressed. Six months later, James has been much recovered under the care of two old men. At this time, Suki has climbed up to be a senior and important person in Wong's firm. Even Lee becomes a blocking stone in her eyes..

programme.title: 秋天的童話
programme.desc: Lee Kay goes to college in New York City and also to visit her boyfriend Dickson. The one to meet her at the airport is a distant relative Boat Head..

programme.title: 痴情快婿
programme.desc: Leon busts an international drug ring at Singapore in a startling fight sequence that will shock even the most jaded filmgoer. From there on it's laughs galore when Leon arrives on Hong Kong with his wife to be who is then kidnapped by her own father who objects to her marrying a police officer. Frankie Chan immediately comes to the aid of his long time friend and in a series of exciting sequences they pursue Leon's missing fiance. Together they encounter her father's bumbling gangster, the vivaciously devious Sharon Kwok, and a team of deadly western agents sent to destroy them. In an explosive finale laughter takes a backseat to tension as the two battle overwhelming odds and just when all appears lost Frankie comes to the rescue.

programme.title: 殺手之王
programme.desc: With a box of worthless war bonds, an old man hired the King of Killers to assassinate a Japanese trade lord. In WWII, the trade lord's action had caused grave damage to the family of the King of Killers. He agrees to take the job and delivers in a few days. The Revenge Fund set up by the trade lord kicks in. Whoever avenges the trade lord's death, killing the killer and the force behind him, will receive a reward of $1 billion. The police assigns Inspector to watch the killers, with orders to leave them room when they kill each other. Among the killers vying for the reward are Fu, a new immigrant, and his agent, Wong a longtime loser trying to score a big one riding on Fu's coat-tail. After an elaborately orchestrated chain of events, Wong and Fu manage to accomplish their goal.

programme.title: 萬象「芳」華: 新仙鶴神針
programme.desc: While the world of martial arts is in probably the most peaceful period for a long while, the Tien Lung Tribe suddenly emerges with a strong military presence as if it were to conquer the warring society. As its presence begin to stir up everyone in the scene, the Court decides to order the leader of the Six Fan Gates – Cho Hung to gather the ten most esteemed tribes for a conference in an attempt to prevent any chaos or unnecessary warfare in the community..

programme.title: 旺角的天空3終極邊緣
programme.desc: Street boy Qian Jidong had been idolizing Pujun, one of the 'Double Eagles in Mong Kok' since childhood. His father was beaten because he owed Xiyang a loan, so Qian Jidong went to Xiyang desperately, but was captured by Xiyang. At a critical moment, Pujun appeared and saved his life. Then, Qian Jidong worked for Pujun. But Qian Jidong's girlfriend GIGI did not like him working in the underworld and finally broke up with him..

programme.title: 咖喱辣椒
programme.desc: Two cops--both best friends and partners--both become the subject of a beautiful news reporter's documentary. The two soon find themselves competing for screen time as well as the love of the reporter while after a murderous arms dealer.

programme.title: 快餐車
programme.desc: Thomas and David are two quick-witted vendors hawking Chinese fast food from their truck in the busy squares of Barcelona. Their acquaintance with beautiful pickpocket, Sylvia, brings them in contact with novice detective Moby, who is trying to track her whereabouts. Sylvia is actually a wealthy heiress kidnapped by the evil count, who is trying to siphon off her inheritance. The trio puts a spanner in the count's plans, and rescue Sylvia..

programme.title: 上天救命
programme.desc: Mak born unlucky, he is driven to despair after a series of depressing events and got himself into a car accident. As he passed out, his spirit went to hell where the devils told him that he will die after the deaths of the Millionaire Wong, Ms. Pao and Mr. Shek. Soon Mak came to his senses. At the same time, a big bag is thrown at him from a passing car. Inside it is the dead body of Millionaire Wong. Mak went to warn Pao only to find her murdered. Mak tried to convince Shek by telling him about the deaths of Millionaire Wong and Pao but Shek didn't believe him. In total desperation, Mak turned to Shek's sister for help. At midnight, Shek had a meeting..

programme.title: 點指兵兵
programme.desc: A young man who was addicted to firearms wanted to be admitted to the police. He was not admitted because of his eye disease, which caused him psychological imbalance and he killed people everywhere. The police set up a special unit to arrest him. A fledgling policeman met the murderer on a narrow road..

programme.title: 喋血街頭
programme.desc: In 1967, Hong Kong, Ben, Paul, and Frank are childhood friends and members of a gang. They regularly brawl with members of other gangs..

programme.title: 逆天者
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Feng was an orphan. When he went on a date with a writer Zhi, Zhi died unexpectedly. After Feng was out of prison, his father's old friend Wei took him home to stay temporarily. One day, Feng received mysterious phone message from a woman Qi, and then he began to be deeply in love with her. Under the guidance of Wei, a love expert, Feng finally won Qi's heart. Wei suddenly arrived while Feng and Qi were having their breakfast in bed..

programme.title: 戀戰沖繩
programme.desc: Jenny wakes up and decides to leave her lover Sato, a triad boss. She takes Sato's ransom money to Tang, who has a diary with explicit details of Sato's triad activities.

programme.title: 上天救命
programme.desc: Mak born unlucky, he is driven to despair after a series of depressing events and got himself into a car accident. As he passed out, his spirit went to hell where the devils told him that he will die after the deaths of the Millionaire Wong, Ms. Pao and Mr. Shek. Soon Mak came to his senses. At the same time, a big bag is thrown at him from a passing car. Inside it is the dead body of Millionaire Wong. Mak went to warn Pao only to find her murdered. Mak tried to convince Shek by telling him about the deaths of Millionaire Wong and Pao but Shek didn't believe him. In total desperation, Mak turned to Shek's sister for help. At midnight, Shek had a meeting..

programme.title: 蜀山傳
programme.desc: Between the heaven and the Earth exist the Zu's mountain range, where live the immortals of Omei, the highest mountain of Zu, but the kingdom is in danger by Amnesia..

programme.title: 流氓醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Mack Lau gives up his career in a famed hospital and opens a clinic in a run-down place. Not only does he heal the residences' wounds, but also their torn-and-broken hearts.

programme.title: 告別有情天
programme.desc: The film was set in the 1970s, Dai Cheng-wah was a top law student in the University of Hong Kong. He fell in love with an orphan Suk-fun. His father opposed this relationship. The lovers eventually got married and Suk-fun dropped out of school because of pregnancy. Cheng-wah continued his studies and graduated. Under his father's influence, he was only able to work in a shabby law firm. After Suk-fun gave birth to triplets, Cheng-wah had a heavy burden. Finally, Cheng-wah won lawsuit and gained fame. However, Suk-fun suddenly discovered she had terminal illness..

programme.title: 飛虎精英之人間有情
programme.desc: SWAT team member Dee is forced to go into action beyond the call of duty when his drunken father falls foul of local triad chief Hung Kwan. Hung is determined to dispose of Dee, despite the fact that his own daughter is in love with him. Dee is forced to fight for his life, and finally realizes how much his father really loves him..

programme.title: 萬象「芳」華: 逃學威龍三之龍過雞年
programme.desc: The Millionaire, Million Wong, is found dead in a hotelroom. The police head officer, Mr. Ta Wang Lai, orders Chau Sing Sing to be an undercover again for further investigation.

programme.title: 我愛一碌葛
programme.desc: Kudzu, Mud Carp and Bean depend on each other for survival since their parents died. Kudzu, the eldest of three sisters, gave up her studies and runs a fish stall in Luen Yee Hui market to raise her two young sisters. She is a super fan of the famous Singer, Alex. Mud Carp, the second sister, becomes a lawyer after university. Her boyfriend, David, comes from a rich family. In view of this, she dares not tell David her family background even though they are planning to get married. Kudzu always hopes her youngest sister Bean, to further her studies but she falls in love with a middle-aged butcher, Wing. One day, Kudzu discovers that her good friend, Keung, has a long-lost brother, and comes to the hopeful conclusion that his lost brother is Alex. In the process of helping Keung to find his brother, the relationship between the three sisters changed..

programme.title: 新流氓醫生
programme.desc: University of Hong Kong graduate Situ Luo was a young, highly skilled and promising physician. Ann, a nurse in the same hospital with him, was his girlfriend. Because of work, Luo felt that he could not take care of his girlfriend, and then proposed break up to Ann. He introduced her to her long-admired friend and colleague Xi. Unexpectedly, Xi was shot dead. Only Luo was beside him before he died, so he became the biggest suspected murderer. Because of brain stimulation and loss of memory, Luo then pleaded guilty and was sentenced to prison..

programme.title: 飛鷹計劃
programme.desc: Jackie the Condor is having his adventures, and Baron calls on him for help. Baron gives him an assistant Chinese scholar Ada, to locate and take back the gold hidden by the Nazis.

programme.title: 蜀山傳
programme.desc: Between the heaven and the Earth exist the Zu's mountain range, where live the immortals of Omei, the highest mountain of Zu, but the kingdom is in danger by Amnesia..

programme.title: 英雄本色
programme.desc: Tse-Ho works for the Triad, the deal in Taiwan turns out to be a trap by the Taiwanese gang. A shootout ensues in which Ho and Shing flee, pursued by local law enforcement. Ho's father is killed, he pleads with Kit to forgive his brother. Ho is released from prison three years later. Remorseful and determined to start a new life, he finds work as a driver for a taxi company, run by another ex-con. Ho spots Mark during one of his shifts; in contrast to Mark's letters, he realizes that Mark has been reduced to an errand boy for Shing (who is the new leader of the Triad). During an emotional reunion, Mark asks Ho to take revenge on Shing and reclaim their positions in the organization, but Ho refuses. Shing finds Ho and presses him to come back to his organization, offering to reinstate Mark if he returns. Ho flatly refuses. Consequently, Shing begins harassing Ho in order to get him to return, including luring Kit into a trap and injuring Kit, attacking Ho's co-workers, and hav.

programme.title: 南海十三郎
programme.desc: The movie bases itself on the life of 'Naam Hoi Sap Saam Long' who was a gifted, famed and productive playwright in the 1930s.

programme.title: 絕世好Bra
programme.desc: Samantha, the president of a renowned brassiere company, breaks the tradition and hires two guys, Johnny and Wayne, as brassiere designers, and requires them to submit novel design in 3 months. Lena, is discontent with this decision deliberately make things difficult for them, those two newcomers to the brassiere industry thus act like buffoon. The time is coming. Can those two guys really work out the 'Ultimate Bra'.

programme.title: 皇家師姐
programme.desc: Senior Police Inspector Ng is assigned to work with another lady inspector from Scotland Yard, to investigate the murder of an agent from the Commercial Crime Bureau of London, who was killed because of the evidence he has collected against a crime syndicate in Hong Kong. As the duo try to work around each other's polarized cultures and background, they kick and punch their way through the investigation, leading to 2 small time pickpockets Strepsil and Panadol, who had stolen the passport containing the evidence from the agent before he died. As the bumbling pickpockets try to dodge the assassins in hot pursuit, they eventually turn to the lady cops for help against the crime boss..

programme.title: 我左眼見到鬼
programme.desc: May marries Daniel during holiday and inherits all money after his death. One night she suffers a fatal car accident. Ken comes to save her life and strange things happen..

programme.title: 嚦咕嚦咕新年財
programme.desc: Years ago Andy's passion for Mahjong cost his family their entire fortune, his brother Louis then turned against him. Thus now Louis suffers from economy downturn..

programme.title: 呆佬拜壽
programme.desc: Ji Fu, the successor of Ji's family, becomes an idiot after being knocked out in an 'accident' created by the second-successor Ji Jack. After being an idiot, Fu meets Mon Tee..

programme.title: 龍少爺
programme.desc: Dragon and Kan are childhood friends who spend most of their free time chasing after local girls in general and spying on one in particular who catches their eyes. A gang in the nearby dwelling is smuggling precious Chinese artifacts to westerners. Hai Huo is a reluctant party to the scheme and when he voiced his objection, the big boss sent his henchmen after him to keep him quiet. When the mischievous duo came across Hai Huo, who was hiding in their village, they take on the gang to protect the artifacts.

programme.title: 雷霆特警
programme.desc: Zhao libing, an outstanding member of the Hong Kong special police force, was selected to attend special training in Seoul. During the training process, Bing met Li Ziping and Jin Yuqi, and instructor Zhang was very strict with them. After the graduation ceremony, Bing said goodbye to Qi and Ping and Cheng Zhengde sent her to the airport. They were busy with their jobs. Bing cracked a counterfeit banknote case in Hong Kong. One of the prisoners was willing to be a tainted witness and said that the mastermind was in South Korea. Bing accompanied with the Interpol to escort the tainted witness to Seoul..

programme.title: 萬象「芳」華: 金枝玉葉2
programme.desc: With the help of her lover, Sam, Wing impersonated a male image and became a pop singer. But Fong Yim Mui wrecked the relationship when they both had an affair with her..

programme.title: 妖獸都市
programme.desc: Sometimes in the future...The world's humans co-exist in a delicate balance with highly evolved 'Creature', living beings who have taken on the physical form of humans and emulate human comportment. But in times of crisis, these creatures revert to their basic animalistic instincts...with corresponding beastlike behaviour..

programme.title: 致命性騷擾
programme.desc: Office worker Amy goes berserk and tries to stab her boss, Cheuk, accusing him of sexual harassment and rape. The higher-ups accept Amy's description of the event and Cheuk is suspended, in spite of the fact that in-house lawyer Joe believes the man is innocent..

programme.desc: Mildly entertaining low-budget quickie that basically rips off Great Teacher Onizuka with less drama and a much less appealing lead actor. Nick Cheung is a triad who's hired by old classmate Lo May to teach a class of reprobates.

programme.desc: Lena, Johnny and Wayne are commissioned to expand a new line of business specializing in merchandise for infants named 'Mighty Baby'. Johnny, enjoying his new perks as a supervising executive, hires a neurotic secretary Sabrina. Knowing that her boyfriend Wayne is a 'baby-phobic', Lena seeks help from Boey, an expert in child behavioral patterns..

programme.title: 鎗王
programme.desc: The key witness of a famous trial and 6 cops are assassinated. Miu knows Rick is back. Years ago in a shooting contest, Rick and Miu knew they were borne to be the sworn enemies.

programme.title: 整蠱王
programme.desc: Happy specializes in playing tricks, but he refuses to work for rich man Shi. By coincidence, Happy meets Moon and falls for her. However, he is not aware it is just a trick..

programme.title: 唐山大兄
programme.desc: Cheng was a Chinese man who moves to Thailand to live with his cousins and works in an ice factory. When a block of ice is accidentally broken, a bag of white powder falls out..

programme.title: 賭俠
programme.desc: Little Knife is following in his master's footsteps and rapidly rising in th gambling world. Sing Chi would like to be the God of Gamblers' disciple and ask him for help..

programme.title: 縱橫四海
programme.desc: A trio of art burglars Joe, Jim & Cherie were orphans raised by Mr Chow and trained into pretty thieves. But they advanced to the big time. Stealing paintings proved to be most lucrative..

programme.title: 摩登保鏢
programme.desc: Comedy trio the Hui Brothers' produce and star in this hilarious and off the wall laugh-fest and box-office hit, Security Unlimited. Michael Hui stars as head security guard Chou, whose unorthodox, and at times ridiculous approach to training his subordinates doesn't seem to go down well with his boss, Fan (Stanley Fung). Sam (Sam Hui) and Bruce (Ricky Hui) are Chou's favorite targets of abuse, but Chou soon finds the shoe is on the other foot when Ricky gets promoted after saving the day in a botched bank heist.

programme.title: 萬象「芳」華: 鍾無艷
programme.desc: On his hunting trip, Emperor Qi takes a wrong turn and is confronted by bandit leader/wild beauty Wu Yen. The two are immediately attracted to each other. However, an ugly mole on Wu Yen's face thwarts this match made in heaven. Emperor Qi cancels the wedding for fear of marrying someone ugly. The mole is the result of a 'love spell' put by enchantress Yin Chun, who is actually an incarnation of a 3000-years old fox with great magical power..

programme.title: 癲佬正傳
programme.desc: Social worker Fun specializes in counseling psychotics. Writer Yip is inspired by his mission and decides to work with him. One day, Fung is accidentally killed by a patient..

programme.title: 江湖龍虎鬥
programme.desc: Wing and Fat have the same burning ambition to be big in the underworld. They struggle and are doing very well, so well the kingpin of the gangs wants to get rid of them. Wing and Fat are forced to fight back, then the showdown comes..

programme.title: 油尖少爺
programme.desc: Zhan's family was very rich, but his wife died early. He and his daughter Baby depended on each other. Zhan liked dancing in nightclub which his daughter opposed. Therefore, she dressed up to work in the nightclub in order to make her dad mad. A gangster had an interest in Baby, but fortunately Cong came forward to help. Baby and Cong developed feelings for each other. Baby used her wealth to help Cong with his career, but when Cong found out that his career was helped by Baby secretly, it was difficult for him to accept. How should Cong decide.

programme.title: 屍家重地
programme.desc: On a remote island off Hong Kong, its rich and happy inhabitants are celebrating an annual ritual by staging an operatic show. The island is not productive but its people are rich. No wonder police chief Yuan Kuei becomes suspicious. He thinks he is sitting on top of a narcotics ring. His two men are ordered to watch closely movement of the opera people. Little does the chief know that actually the islanders are living off the loot their ancestors made by raiding a government gold galleon some centuries ago. They buried much of the treasure and a dormant vampire under a pagoda. Two actresses and a tutor from the troupe get to the pagoda by accident, followed by the three policemen..

programme.title: 精裝追女仔
programme.desc: Fred, foul-mouthed, together with his two close buddies, Silver and Tony, are working in a garage. Their boss, Ken, is harsh and dingy. However, a warm and close friendship has been established among the four. In order to recover the heartbreak of Fred, Ken suggested a tour to Penang to cheer up Fred. They came across two beautiful girls, Maggie and Agnes, strolling leisurely on the beach as if they were very wealthy. Since then they decided on courtship. They played a poker game to decide who's to who. And Fred, the winner, chose Maggie to be his sole target. By the rules of the game, Ken, Silver and Tong have to compete to see who in the ends will win the heart of Agnes..

programme.title: 賭聖2之街頭賭聖
programme.desc: Lui puts forward a masked Saint of gamblers to cover for him in the casino. Meanwhile, Uncle Sam sets out in search of the new Saint since the real saint of gamblers retires..

programme.title: 君子好逑
programme.desc: A group of intellectuals, who all actively involved in a psychological research, assume a subject Fai, who is innocent and aimless in his life, to test if love can make him into a different person. Jo Jo is the chosen girl to carry out the mission, who attracts Fai with her elegance and beauty. At the same time, she finds herself attracted by him. She wants Professor Cheung, her boyfriend, to stop such a cruel test, but she fails. The final commitment comes when Jo Jo marries to Cheung. Fai interrupts the wedding ceremony in the church by announcing his love to Jo Jo..

programme.title: 求戀期
programme.desc: The friends of Choi and his girlfriend Mimi always say that the two of them do not look like a couple. So, Choi decides to change his image to be more 'punky'. However, Mimi not only spurns his changes, but also feels there are some problems between them and asks for a break-up. Paul is a 'playboy'. In a rainy night, he meets Yung. She has an unpredictable character. Paul's courtship skills do not work on her. Paul is helpless. Indeed, Yung likes Paul but she is afraid that one day she may really fall in love with Paul so she goes back to Canada. Though unwilling, Paul has to put an end to this relationship.

programme.title: 影人映語 -方丈的闊達 - 劉以達
programme.desc: After formed the musical group “Tat Ming Pair”, Tats Lau had been involved as a film composer in the industry for the first time. His taciturn image was changing over when he was invited by Stephen Chow to have a cameo in one of his works; then Lau's another role playing the abbot even provided a major boost to his career as a comedy actor. How does he feel when looking back at his experience throughout these years? Also, perceiving that Hong Kong is his ‘root', what kind of wisdom he would like to share with the audience.

programme.title: 衛斯理藍血人
programme.desc: Wesley is a member of the United Nation Aliens Analyzing Agency, and no stranger to extraterrestrial sightings. This time he finds himself face to face with Fong, a blue-blooded alien stranded on earth. Wesley and his girlfriend So promise to help Fong, but they must first combat FBI's powerful X Unit, who intends to capture Fong for their experiments. Making matters worse is the arrival of two aliens from Fong's home planet, determined to kill anyone that prevents them from retrieving their own species..

programme.title: 半斤八兩
programme.desc: Joseph Wong (Michael Hui), the kingpin of the Manix Private Detective Agency, a firm believer in tact and thrift. By tact, he means you can cheat all the people all the time and corners are there to be cut. By thrift, he means an underpaid staff is happy and grateful staff. By chance, he employs Lee Kwok Kit (Samuel Hui). Together, they have solved lots of wired cases. One day, while the two are investigating a blackmail case, the movie goes off and the lights come on. Scores of gun-toting hoods hold the more than 1,000 goers as hostages. On the stage Uncle Gaw (Shek Kin) threatens that it is a hold-up.

programme.title: River Hunters 第1季第3集 -English Civil War - Newark Trent
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette, head to the vast River Trent and site of one of the greatest strongholds of the English Civil War - Newark Castle. Here on the banks of the waterway in 1645, the forces of King Charles I were trapped in a bloody siege by Scottish forces from the North and Parliamentarian armies from the South. In the first official search of the waterway, the River Hunters will be searching for lost Civil War relics that reveal the secrets of this brutal battleground.

programme.desc: Leysath is joined by his son, Jake, for a unique experience chasing an invasive Asian antelope in south Texas. programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: In the land of ten thousand lakes, Leech Lake stands out, because it's the third largest lake located entirely within the state of Minnesota. Known as a destination for walleye, pike and muskie fishing, Leech Lake attracts fishermen from all over the Midwest... and that's where the trouble began. Fishermen from the Ohio River Basin brought rusty crawfish up to Leech Lake as bait... and when done fishing, they released them, inadvertently giving the rusty crayfish a new home. Now, the rustys are pushing out the native crayfish, and destroying the weed beds the muskie, pike and walleye depend on. Fishing guide Phil Bauerly sees the destruction daily. To combat the rustys, Phil regularly throws lakeside crayfish boils for family and friends... and Yia just received his invitation to join.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: Common carp are one of the most widely introduced species of fish in the world. However, most people in the U.S. won't eat them, referring to them as a 'trash fish.' Bowfisherman and fishing guide Curt Cich will tell you otherwise, as these fish are fun to bowhunt, have plenty of fresh meat and are delicious smoked. These fish are so plentiful, Curt runs a year-round full-time guiding service targeting only carp.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In the most action packed trip yet, Rooftop and Catfish’s trip to Thailand has them face to face with the country’s nature. They wrestle a crocodile, charm a cobra, and get a massage from an elephant that’s somehow more relaxing than the traditional Thai massages they tried out. The two even attempt to catch (cooked) flying chickens on their heads. Things relaxed in Thailand for a moment when the BMX bikers got to balance out this animal packed experience with the spiritual side of the country, each getting Sak Yant, a traditional Thai tattoo. However, the relaxation was short-lived as Catfish and Rooftops’s final battle in Thailand requires them to make it out of a May Thai boxing match alive.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here 第2季
programme.desc: If the altitude doesn't get you, the traffic will! That's what Andrew Younghusband learns in the exotic South American city of La Paz, where rules of the road are optional and definitely quirky.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Western Australia’s Murchison GeoRegion is well known for its’ ancient landscapes and\nbrilliant skies, this is the real outback. We take a journey through a region full of stories dating back to\nthe earth’s beginning, around 4½ billion years ago.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc:
Part One of a journey along the Kamilaroi Highway, from Willow Tree to Moree, in New
South Wales, taking in The Great Divide on our way to the Great Australian Outback. Magnificent
landscapes, awesome attractions, and we meet some really cool people as we make our way through
a region which traditional owners are spiritually connected to.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here 第2季
programme.desc: If the altitude doesn't get you, the traffic will! That's what Andrew Younghusband learns in the exotic South American city of La Paz, where rules of the road are optional and definitely quirky.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

programme.title: Dead Meat 第6季
programme.desc: Scott Leysath takes a look back at the first 5 seasons of Dead Meat and features 'The Good, the Bad, and the Slimy.' The journey has been full of surprises, but they weren't all good.

programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

programme.title: River Hunters 第1季第4集 -Vikings - River Trent
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette, take on the vast River Trent, following in the bloody footsteps of the Vikings as they invaded 9th century Britain. In the first ever archaeological river search of key Viking sites, they’ll be hunting for relics of Chief Ivar The Boneless and the Great Heathen Army as they conquered the Anglo-Saxon Kings of England.

programme.title: Bear's Mission With Anthony Joshua 第1季
programme.desc: Adventurer Bear Grylls teaches the unified world heavyweight champion some alternative survival skills.

programme.title: Bear's Mission With Rob Brydon 第1季
programme.desc: Funny man Rob Brydon joins Bear Grylls for an adventure he won’t forget as he takes on a mission in the Mountains of Snowdonia.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

雙城記-兩岸主播逛香港
programme.desc: 第二集《發現屯門》通過講述屯門的過去、現在，及未來的展望，來發現「不一樣的香港」。兩岸三地的主持人，與嘉賓一起搭上屯馬線及輕鐵，探訪屯門的宜居和交通便捷，同時還有連接內地的地理優勢。通過走訪掃管笏遺址、有「香港千島湖」之稱的大纜涌，屯門陶淵明後人聚居區——藍地等處，帶觀眾瞭解屯門名字的由來，以及過去在香港的地位和作用。而三聖邨，黃金海岸旅遊區、屯門公園、藝術新地標等地，則展現屯門有別於香港市區不同又獨具魅力的自然風光景色.

programme.title: 廣播道會客室
programme.sub-title: 由股票到多元資產——陳翊庭談港交所新航程
programme.desc: 《廣播道會客室》走進港交所，主持林健鋒專訪行政總裁陳翊庭。由聯交所成立四十周年談起，陳翊庭分享自己由法律界、投資銀行到市場監管的多元經歷，以及女性領導者推動董事會性別多元化的體會。面對國家「十五五」規劃及香港金融市場新機遇，她詳談優化上市制度、提升市場流動性、發展人民幣產品，並拓展債券、貨幣、大宗商品及黃金期貨，帶領港交所由股票交易平台邁向多元資產生態圈，鞏固香港國際金融中心地位。. 想睇更多： https://www.rthk.hk/tv/dtt32/programme/onbroadcastdrive/. 逢星期五｜晚上七點半｜港台電視32. 立即下載「香港電台隨身版(RTHK On The Go)」緊貼最新節目：. https://rthk.hk/otg. 記得LIKE + 訂閱 + 推播通知. #港交所 #林健鋒 #陳翊庭 #聯交所四十周年 #女性 #新股市場 #優化上市制度 #人民幣產品 #債券 #國際金融中心 #貨幣 #大宗商品 #黃金期貨 #多元資產生態圈.

programme.title: 非凡人物
programme.desc: 羅家英出身粵劇世家，1946年生於廣東順德，1949年幼年隨父羅家權來港，承襲多位名師絕學，大半生扎根梨園。他憑藉紮實功架擔正文武生，1973年返港成立英華年劇團，1988年與汪明荃組成福陞粵劇團，更以「貪靚」美學獨樹一幟。90年代他將粵劇身段融入電影，憑《國產凌凌漆》與《女人四十》爆紅，並榮獲金像獎「最佳男配角」。經歷多次大病後，他依然樂觀豁達，傾力推動梨園的薪火相傳。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 曾奕文(音樂學院副教授). 嘉賓：. 羅家英(粵劇名伶). #羅家英#粵劇大老倌#梨園#最佳男配角#薪火相傳#非凡人物#onlyyou.

programme.title: 典故裏的科學 第二季
programme.desc: 諸葛亮是三國蜀漢丞相，被譽為睿才。但是在一種古代防護裝備面前，他也曾吃過苦頭。《三國演義》中，孟獲請來南蠻族的藤甲軍隊。特製藤甲刀槍不入，遇水不沉，輕便靈活，藤甲軍可謂水陸無敵。那麼，《三國演義》中「刀槍不入」的藤甲衣真的存在嗎？科學求證人高澤民將帶大家一探究竟.

programme.title: 典故裏的科學 第二季
programme.desc: 在小學語文課本，一直閃耀着一個神童的傳說，他就是懂得利用浮力给大象秤體重的曹沖。1,800多年前，小曹沖如此逆天的智商的確令人瞠目結舌，再加上他過早夭折，史料極少，更引發了人們對「曹沖稱象」這個典故的質疑。為此，科學求證人高澤民將前往雲南、河北、遼寧三地，探究其中的玄妙.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師陪著小賽思第一次搭乘高速列車。為了讓她覺得旅程不會太漫長，他對她講了火車的歷史。他們來到英國的礦井，在那裡發現了最早用於馬車的木製鐵軌。然後，他們來到1804年，參觀了理查特·里維西克在威爾斯建造的第一台蒸汽機車……但是蒸汽機車是如何工作的呢？尋古大師帶著小女孩乘坐喬治·史蒂芬森發明的「火箭號」蒸汽機車，他們一路追蹤蒸汽，最終找到了驅動車輪的活塞……1900年，火車實現了電動化，污染也減少了！新幹線、TGV高速列車以及速度最快的上海高鐵不斷刷新著速度紀錄.

programme.title: 好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 有一位小學四年級生的小鄰居，小小年紀，便有一個特別的夢想，就是成立一個「笑話義工團」！她希望利用笑聲幫助別人，讓全世界都開心起來！不過，好友卻極力勸阻她，認為講笑話不是一種服務，不能成立義工團。就在小鄰居心灰意冷之際，Harry哥哥及時出現，貓頭鷹博士更引用《基本法》第一百四十六條解答她的疑惑；原來香港的志願團體，只要合法，都可以自由選擇自己的服務方式！但是貓頭鷹博士贊成成立笑話義工團時，卻反對她的做法？到底背後有甚麼不可告人的秘密？. 《基本法》第一百四十六條：. 香港特別行政區從事社會服務的志願團體在不抵觸法律的情況下可自行決定其服務方式。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: In Hong Kong, people are living longer lives. But what does longevity look like in everyday life? We follow several elders over the age of 80 to see how they spend their days. . Longevity is a blessing, but it also brings challenges. As their bodies are not as strong as before, how do they live with more vitality than ever? Among these “post‑80s,” some continue to pursue their passions, some devote themselves to caring for their spouses, and others enjoy the happiness of a large family. What are their secrets to longevity, and what gives their lives meaning.

香港故事 ---近水留情
programme.sub-title: Passion for Windsurfing in Kwun Yam Wan
programme.desc: Hong Kong has a total of 261 outlying islands, and Cheung Chau may be one of the most well-known islands among Hong Kong people. In 1996, LEE Lai-shan, the indigenous inhabitant of Cheung Chau, won Hong Kong’s first Olympic gold medal in windsurfing. Since then, there has been an inseparable relationship between Cheung Chau and windsurfing, and many people were attracted to Kwun Yam Wan, the venue famous for practising windsurfing by LEE. . Since its establishment by Derek’s grandfather, the store at the end of Kwun Yam Wan Beach has been passed down to the third generation, with a history of over 70 years. It has witnessed the ups and downs of windsurfing in Cheung Chau. Although the store remains on the same beach, it has been passed down from generation to generation, and the mode of operation is different for each generation. Derek, the successor of the third generation, has injected an extraordinary vitality into the store. . Living on the island and growing up on the beach, Derek has fond feelings for the sea. Apart from working in the store, Derek is also passionate about windsurfing. His passion for water-based sports has influenced his son Jadon, making it possible for Jadon to become a member of the Hong Kong Wingfoil Youth Team and represent Hong Kong in competitions. Being known as a “Cheung Chau boy”, Jadon is not just passionate about wingfoiling. What’s more, he wants to be recognised as a “Cheung Chau windsurfer”. Maybe this is the sense of identity passed down by Cheung Chau windsurfers. . Apart from the indigenous inhabitants of Cheung Chau, people from outside the island are also attracted by Kwun Yam Wan and windsurfing. Stephanie moved to Cheung Chau with her mother in her teens. When she was young, she was not particularly fond of water-based sports. It was not until her thirties that she happened to learn windsurfing, and has lived a different life since then. . Windsurfing is just a medium allowing different kinds of “Cheung Chau people” to get up close with the sea and feel the unique charm of the Cheung Chau island.

31看世界 - 周遊列車- 再出發
programme.sub-title: 周遊列車 再出發 - 巴西
programme.desc: 菲臘登上里約熱內盧一列原創味十足的通勤火車。乘客在火車上能買到很多商品，還有一位駐火車按摩師為乘客按摩。他又坐上世界上最長的火車，穿過里約熱內盧東北部及部分亞馬遜雨林。這片森林生物多樣性豐富，森林中人還保留著獨特的儀式。例如薩特雷-馬韋族落年輕人的成年禮，讓毒蟻叮咬雙手。菲臘見識過這些儀式後，前往南部的坎普斯-杜若爾當。巴西人無需離開國家，在這裏就能享受歐陸風情。菲臘再前往大西洋沿岸，在那裏登上一艘軌道風帆，感受純風力驅動的航行，為旅程畫上完美句號。 The journey begins in Rio de Janeiro, where he travels on a highly original commuter train. It sells everything, and even has a masseur offering his services directly in the carriages. Philippe then took the world's largest train, which travelled through the north-east of the country and crossed part of the Amazon rainforest. A forest rich in biodiversity and also in unusual rituals. Like the rite of passage to adulthood for the young members of the Satere-Mawe tribe: they have to have their hands stung by poisonous ants. After this encounter, we head south to Campo De Jordao, where the Brazilians can discover a piece of Europe without leaving their country. To round off the trip, the Brazilians head for the Atlantic coast, where a sail-powered tugboat will take Philippe on a journey powered only by the wind.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈：荷里活電影音樂之夜
programme.desc: 今個聖誕假期，我們將會帶領觀眾們前往丹麥電台音樂廳，經歷一場璀璨的荷里活電影音樂之旅。丹麥國家交響樂團夥拍廣受歡迎的女孩合唱團「DR Junior Choir」，以及才華洋溢的年輕歌唱家，一同演奏多首膾炙人口的荷里活電影音樂。當中包括：《鐵達尼號》、《加勒比海盜》、《護花傾情》、《侏羅紀公園》及《E.T.》等等。另外，音樂會亦加設了一個特備環節，向出色的奧斯卡電影配樂致敬。想在佳節與親朋摯愛，安坐家中欣賞一場音樂盛宴，便不能錯過《荷里活電影之夜》音樂會。. 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2024年12月28日 星期六 中午1時 . DR Koncerthuset rolls out the red carpet for a sparkling Hollywood gala with the DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir, Andrea Oehlenschlæger and Diluckshan Jeyratnam. The audience awaits a musical firework display from the best Hollywood films such as “Titanic”, "Pirates of the Caribbean", " The Bodyguard”, “Jurassic Park”and "E.T." - and many more. The evening also features a special section dedicated to the best music from the iconic Oscars. . Channel: RTHK 31 Time: (First Run) 2024.12.28 SAT 1:00pm.

programme.desc: 兩位主持人阮頌陽、嚴崇天及一班太陽使者蓄勢待發，準備踏上「文旅小記者」的新彊旅程！出發前，小記者先經過培訓，由不同領域的專業人士分享拍攝和說故事的技巧，之後再到深圳前海參觀，了解人工智能，創新產業以及深港兩地青年人發展的機遇。經過一輪準備之後，正式踏足新彊，從有「優美牧場」之稱的「烏魯木齊」，再出發到群山環抱的天山天池，他們帶著各自的青澀與期待，踏上了一趟未知的旅程。每組太陽使者要在有限時間發揮創意錄製影片，過程中有吵有罵、有笑也有淚，也經歷了一趟自我成長的過程。旅程中亦發生一段小插曲，當中一位太陽使者的太公曾經為新彊兵團打拼，他的事跡亦可能收藏於新彊兵團軍墾博物館，究竟這次新疆尋根之旅，能否讓他尋找到太公的足跡？. 主持：阮頌揚、嚴崇天. *************************************************************************. 太陽計劃2026由香港電台、香港中華文化發展聯合會主辦，保華基金會贊助，並獲民青局青年內地交流資助計劃資助。（本宣傳品僅代表主辦機構之立場.

programme.title: 傳媒初體驗 第三季

programme.desc: 八強戰況愈鬥愈烈，新仇舊恨全面炸裂！新生命教育協會平安福音中學連環向基督教香港信義會心誠中學發動「魔鬼戰書」，勢將對方推向淘汰邊緣！「無言以對」的心誠被迫接受命運捉弄，更慘遭無情投訴？田家炳中學齊心趕赴Gen Z集中地，卻誤闖「禁區」？八強進入最後倒數階段，極限剪接引爆生死時速，誰能突破時限，搶下終極四強入場券.

programme.title: 香港故事 ---近水留情
programme.sub-title: Passion for Windsurfing in Kwun Yam Wan
programme.desc: Hong Kong has a total of 261 outlying islands, and Cheung Chau may be one of the most well-known islands among Hong Kong people. In 1996, LEE Lai-shan, the indigenous inhabitant of Cheung Chau, won Hong Kong’s first Olympic gold medal in windsurfing. Since then, there has been an inseparable relationship between Cheung Chau and windsurfing, and many people were attracted to Kwun Yam Wan, the venue famous for practising windsurfing by LEE. . Since its establishment by Derek’s grandfather, the store at the end of Kwun Yam Wan Beach has been passed down to the third generation, with a history of over 70 years. It has witnessed the ups and downs of windsurfing in Cheung Chau. Although the store remains on the same beach, it has been passed down from generation to generation, and the mode of operation is different for each generation. Derek, the successor of the third generation, has injected an extraordinary vitality into the store. . Living on the island and growing up on the beach, Derek has fond feelings for the sea. Apart from working in the store, Derek is also passionate about windsurfing. His passion for water-based sports has influenced his son Jadon, making it possible for Jadon to become a member of the Hong Kong Wingfoil Youth Team and represent Hong Kong in competitions. Being known as a “Cheung Chau boy”, Jadon is not just passionate about wingfoiling. What’s more, he wants to be recognised as a “Cheung Chau windsurfer”. Maybe this is the sense of identity passed down by Cheung Chau windsurfers. . Apart from the indigenous inhabitants of Cheung Chau, people from outside the island are also attracted by Kwun Yam Wan and windsurfing. Stephanie moved to Cheung Chau with her mother in her teens. When she was young, she was not particularly fond of water-based sports. It was not until her thirties that she happened to learn windsurfing, and has lived a different life since then. . Windsurfing is just a medium allowing different kinds of “Cheung Chau people” to get up close with the sea and feel the unique charm of the Cheung Chau island.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 周遊列車- 再出發
programme.sub-title: 周遊列車 再出發 - 巴西
programme.desc: 菲臘登上里約熱內盧一列原創味十足的通勤火車。乘客在火車上能買到很多商品，還有一位駐火車按摩師為乘客按摩。他又坐上世界上最長的火車，穿過里約熱內盧東北部及部分亞馬遜雨林。這片森林生物多樣性豐富，森林中人還保留著獨特的儀式。例如薩特雷-馬韋族落年輕人的成年禮，讓毒蟻叮咬雙手。菲臘見識過這些儀式後，前往南部的坎普斯-杜若爾當。巴西人無需離開國家，在這裏就能享受歐陸風情。菲臘再前往大西洋沿岸，在那裏登上一艘軌道風帆，感受純風力驅動的航行，為旅程畫上完美句號。 The journey begins in Rio de Janeiro, where he travels on a highly original commuter train. It sells everything, and even has a masseur offering his services directly in the carriages. Philippe then took the world's largest train, which travelled through the north-east of the country and crossed part of the Amazon rainforest. A forest rich in biodiversity and also in unusual rituals. Like the rite of passage to adulthood for the young members of the Satere-Mawe tribe: they have to have their hands stung by poisonous ants. After this encounter, we head south to Campo De Jordao, where the Brazilians can discover a piece of Europe without leaving their country. To round off the trip, the Brazilians head for the Atlantic coast, where a sail-powered tugboat will take Philippe on a journey powered only by the wind.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 賽思和彼德正計劃他們的婚禮，但他們弄丟了戒指！尋古大師想幫彼德尋找一些新的結婚戒指，於是帶他回到史前時期，當時的戒指是用長毛象牙造。在古時候，人們把印章戴在手指上簽署重要文件。在中世紀，每隻手指都戴戒指的做法很普遍。而在文藝復興時期，波吉亞家族專門製作毒藥戒指！他們找到的所有戒指都不適合彼德，於是尋古大師帶他到一個幻想中的戒指博物館。他肯定能找到想要的東西.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師報名參加了一場無人機競賽，然而他那架小型螺旋槳飛行器卻意外飛出窗外！他立即展開追逐，竟穿越時空來到第一次世界大戰期間的美國，並親眼目睹了軍事武器凱特靈飛蟲的展示，這正是歷史上首架無人機的雛形。尋古大師終於追上自己的無人機，並神奇地縮小身形，騎乘其上如同牛仔馴馬般展開一場奇幻旅程！在這段精彩的冒險中，我們將一同探索無人機的多元用途：從電影拍攝、農業應用、娛樂表演、安全監控，到更多令人驚奇的領域。究竟尋古大師能否及時趕回參加那場激動人心的競賽呢.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 本集中的速度動物寶寶目前尚未達到最高速度，但牠們具備成為地球上最快生物的潛能。小馬駒能夠疾速奔馳，獵豹BB將達到時速約120公里，遊隼雛鳥更將成長為全球最快的鳥類。本集呈現這些非凡動物BB及其對極致速度的天賦需求.

programme.title: 鄉郊豐年節2026：香港山水 · 聲舞 一日音樂節
programme.sub-title: 譚盾與楊麗萍實景樂舞《春之祭 · 輪迴》
programme.desc: 由環境及生態局鄉郊保育辦公室支持，「鄉郊豐年節2026：『香港山水·聲舞』一日音樂節」一連三集為觀眾送上自然與藝術交融的視聽盛宴。. 首章由音樂大師譚盾聯同舞蹈家楊麗萍攜手揭開序幕，以印洲塘荔枝窩的自然山水為舞台，呈獻實景樂舞《春之祭·輪迴》。節目分三幕進行：第一幕演繹斯特拉文斯基《春之祭》，由紐約打擊樂團演奏，舞者董繼蘭與朱鳳偉以現代舞詮釋生命的祭祀與重生；第二幕帶來譚盾作品《九色鹿》，女高音鍾嘉欣唱出佛經故事的慈悲與智慧；第三幕《心經》由陳奕寧以反彈琵琶演繹敦煌樂舞，配上劉俊豪的馬頭琴及呼麥。音樂節片段由環境及生態局鄉郊保育辦公室攝製及提供。. 曲目. 《春之祭》. 指揮：譚盾. 編舞：楊麗萍. 舞者：董繼蘭（金花）、朱鳳偉（大朱）. 鋼琴：弗蘭克、王逸佳. 紐約打擊樂團：安東尼、羅德尼、納撒尼爾、邁克爾. 《九色鹿》. 女高音：鍾嘉欣. 《心經》. 反彈琵琶及敦煌樂舞：陳奕寧. 馬頭琴及呼麥：劉俊豪.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈：粵粹縱橫
programme.desc: 《演藝盛薈：粵粹縱橫》追溯粵樂文化的源頭，將說唱、戲曲和器樂演奏，三大促使粵樂形成的根源融會，讓精華集於一身，呈現既古樸清幽，亦典雅堂皇的風貌。. 竹韻小集特邀「萬能泰斗」阮兆輝及「萬能樂師」高潤鴻合作演出。音樂會以1916年編撰、香港首本粵樂教本《絃歌必讀》為藍本，重新復刻早期的粵樂演奏形式，窺探二十世紀初粵樂文化之風貌及嬗變，反璞歸真，重聞百年粵海遺音，絕對不容錯過。. . 演出曲目. 戲曲(古腔粵曲). 《柳搖金》大調. 《思賢調》大調. 《貴妃醉酒》大調. 說唱(地水南音). 《客途秋恨》南音. 器樂(廣東八音). 《到春來》小調譜. 《一錠金》過場譜. 《雁落平沙》過場譜. 《廣東小調聯奏》小調譜. 《絃歌趣韻》. . 樂團簡介. 竹韻小集成立於2003年，以發揚「香港中樂文化」為重點目標的。樂團為香港青年音樂家組成的專業小型中樂團體，以「本土精英，文化傳承；植根嶺南，融會中西」為藝術特色，除研究及學習傳統民間音樂外，亦致力探索及開拓現代小型中樂的發展空間，展現中國音樂「小而美、簡而精」的獨特魅力。竹韻小集為香港藝術發展局資助團體.

programme.title: 夢想中華人物誌 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 一代華學大師饒宗頤教授，長於治學與鑽研，在國學、文史、考古及藝術創作等二十五門學科中，皆展現卓越才華。他由故鄉潮州起步，在動盪時代中守望文化；移居香港後，更善用中西交匯的優勢，搜羅全球文獻遺珍，在國際學壇寫下輝煌篇章。. 饒公不僅在學術上開創新局，更親身實踐「學藝雙攜」，將鑽研梵文與敦煌經卷等多個學科的深厚學養，熔鑄於個人書畫神韻之中。他深信「二十一世紀是中國文藝復興的時代」，並將這份信念化為行動，於晚年積極推動跨地域學術交流，悉心提攜後輩。其影響力遍及全球，為後世留下了豐厚且生生不息的文化遺產。. 受訪者包括：. 李焯芬教授（香港大學饒宗頤學術館館長、饒宗頤文化館管理委員會主席）. 姚錫安博士（香港大學饒宗頤學術館副館長）. 曾憲通教授（中山大學中文系教授）. 鄭會欣教授（香港中文大學中國文化研究所名譽高級研究員）. 王奮（潮州饒宗頤博物館文博館員.

programme.title: 灣區夢成真
programme.desc: 聚焦初中組第二及第三日的行程，學生將深入探索非遺工藝與自然生態。首先參觀竹文化博覽館，走進極具嶺南特色的竹博園，欣賞以竹字為主題創作的百竹圖。學生亦會參觀肇慶古城牆，親身感受肇慶上千年的歷史底蘊。行程中還安排了互動遊戲和實用資訊分享，讓學生在輕鬆愉快的氛圍中，全面體驗肇慶的文化魅力與自然生態之美.

programme.title: 國寶時刻 – 精裝版
programme.sub-title: 第十一集 仙道佛門・歷朝演繹
programme.desc: 東漢末年之後，中國經歷近三百年的分裂動盪，社會對精神信仰的追求愈發強烈，佛教大規模漢化，道教亦進一步發展成形。本集三件文物——三國吳青瓷釉下彩羽人紋盤口壺、北魏司馬金龍墓石雕棺床、山西平順龍門寺——帶領我們穿梭三國至明清的宗教藝術演變。青瓷壺上的羽人紋反映中國早期神仙信仰，肩部貼塑的佛像則見證佛教已傳播至江南；司馬金龍墓石雕棺床呈現北魏兼容並包的時代精神——力士受犍陀羅風格影響，忍冬紋源自希臘，堪稱當時的全球化設計；龍門寺集歷代建築於一身，是佛教在中國持續本土化的活見證.

programme.title: 周末大電影：窗外是藍星
programme.desc: 中國第一部太空實拍的球幕電影，由航天員翟志剛、王亞平和葉光富親自拍攝，帶領觀眾乘坐神舟十三號飛船前往天宮空間站，追逐太空探索的夢想。三名航天員於二○二一年十月十六日乘坐神舟十三號，進駐天宮空間站，展開為期六個月的太空任務。電影透過航天員操控的鏡頭，讓觀眾沉浸式體驗穿越大氣層的震憾，認識在空間站如何生活和工作。回望地球萬家燈火的璀璨，以獨特視角一睹這顆壯麗藍星的風采.

programme.title: 香港故事: 由AI開始
programme.desc: 《替我活下去》. 科技日新月異，人工智能正以前所未有的速度改寫世界。但當演算法開始模擬聲音與表情，它是否能回應人類最原始的渴望——在有限的生命裡，留下無限的溫度？十七歲的陳梓鍵患有杜興氏肌肉營養不良症。這是一種無法治癒的遺傳疾病，會持續侵蝕肌肉，最終影響心臟與呼吸功能。九歲起，他無法再行走；近年來，肺活量與心臟指數持續下降。醫療報告上的數字清楚顯示：生命正在倒數。多年來，母親辭去工作，全職照顧兒子。日常生活圍繞著輪椅、藥物與呼吸機展開。夜裡機器規律的運轉聲，成為這個家庭的背景音。在這個家裡，死亡不是抽象的哲學問題，而是每天清晨醒來都必須面對的生理現實。然而，梓鍵不願只留下照片與回憶。他想留下的，是一個可以回應、可以對話、能繼續陪伴的「自己」。他決定利用人工智能，建立一個可互動的數字身分。透過高精度面部掃描、長時間語音採集與記憶建模，他將自己的神情、語氣與思考邏輯轉化為數據。他親自參與訓練過程，輸入與母親共享的生活細節，設計未來可能發生的對話場景。他並非追求永生，而是希望在自己離開後，母親仍能聽見他的聲音。當虛擬分身第一次完整運行，母親坐在螢幕前，聽見那熟悉的語調再次回應她。幾乎無法分辨真假的還原度，帶來片刻安慰，也引發深層不安——如果告別變得不再徹底，哀痛會否變得更加沉重？當人工智能介入記憶與失去之間，人類是否準備好承擔這種新的陪伴形式？當梓鍵的身體日漸衰弱，他的數字人格卻逐步完整。兩條軌跡同時向前——一條走向終點，一條通往未知。梓鍵希望：如果有一天我不在了，請讓「我」，繼續陪妳活下去。《替我活下去》是一部關於愛、科技與告別的紀錄片。當肉身註定凋零，愛是否能在代碼之中，找到另一種存在的方式.

programme.title: 廣播道會客室
programme.sub-title: 由股票到多元資產——陳翊庭談港交所新航程
programme.desc: 《廣播道會客室》走進港交所，主持林健鋒專訪行政總裁陳翊庭。由聯交所成立四十周年談起，陳翊庭分享自己由法律界、投資銀行到市場監管的多元經歷，以及女性領導者推動董事會性別多元化的體會。面對國家「十五五」規劃及香港金融市場新機遇，她詳談優化上市制度、提升市場流動性、發展人民幣產品，並拓展債券、貨幣、大宗商品及黃金期貨，帶領港交所由股票交易平台邁向多元資產生態圈，鞏固香港國際金融中心地位。. 想睇更多： https://www.rthk.hk/tv/dtt32/programme/onbroadcastdrive/. 逢星期五｜晚上七點半｜港台電視32. 立即下載「香港電台隨身版(RTHK On The Go)」緊貼最新節目：. https://rthk.hk/otg. 記得LIKE + 訂閱 + 推播通知. #港交所 #林健鋒 #陳翊庭 #聯交所四十周年 #女性 #新股市場 #優化上市制度 #人民幣產品 #債券 #國際金融中心 #貨幣 #大宗商品 #黃金期貨 #多元資產生態圈.

programme.title: 看神州
programme.sub-title: 習近平國事訪美獲高規格接待 北京傳承人創作兔爺泥彩塑
programme.desc: 國家主席習近平時隔11年再次國事訪問美國，獲美國總統特朗普高規格接待，不但親自到機場迎接，又在白宮舉行隆重歡迎儀式。 習近平說，中美不必諱言競爭，但競爭應該是良性的、有邊界的。特朗普表示，會與習近平攜手合作，在兩國面臨的諸多問題上取得重大進展。 雙邊代表、政府官員及商界頂尖領袖出席歡迎國宴。習近平在國宴上致辭時，祝願大家中秋節快樂。 講到中秋，北京在中秋期間有「請兔爺」的傳統，祈求闔家平安，免爺泥彩塑是國家級非物質文化遺產，得以流傳至今，有賴代代傳承人的堅持。 民眾透過親身體驗，可以更深入了解中華文化，四川成都近年興起文物修復體驗。手藝傳承並不局限於藝術作品，湖南岳陽有燒烤學院，教授學生燒烤的技巧。 內地有傳媒揭發，不法份子懷疑以民居作工場，生產劣質冒牌化妝品，執法部分鎖定涉案工程，部署嚴厲打擊。 專家視角就會分析內地早前就人形機械人產業標準體系建設指南，公開徵求意見。 . 《看神州 》專頁： https://www.rthk.hk/tv/dtt32/programme/kanshenzhou . 逢星期一｜晚上7時30分｜港台電視32 立即下載「香港電台隨身版(RTHK On The Go)」緊貼最新節目： https://rthk.hk/otg 記得LIKE + 訂閱+ 推播通知！ . #習近平 #國事訪問 #兔爺泥彩塑 #看神州 #香港電台 #RTHK.
